sketch_notes: Both sketches depict a largely static content page with branding, simple navigation links, article text, and footer-like content. The mobile sketch shows a stacked article layout with a large header area, title block, body text, an inset content box, and bottom links; the desktop sketch shows a compact header with logo and inline navigation above article text. No explicit or strongly implied JavaScript-driven widgets are visible: there is no hamburger icon, dropdown indicator, search field, tabs, accordion, modal trigger, load-more control, sticky treatment, or dynamic status element. The implied implementation is primarily responsive layout and standard hyperlink navigation rather than interactive JavaScript behavior.
